vb_textbox.text: It seemed like it may have been choosing either S or K which was giving better or worse returns. But then it will change from one to the other as the game progresses. Like if you get a few high scores then stick with the same choice until it changes, but also alternatively if you get a few zeros in a row then could be an idea to switch it up. The gnomes themselves seem very inconsistent, and any one can give good or bad results. Saying that, the grey/green one with the flat hat did seem to do rather well a lot of the time. Also, the autumn forest with falling leaves did consistently appear to give a good harvest for all gnomes so that quite possibly is worth considering too.The most important thing is to not be slow on the keyboard whatever you choose though as any missed round adds up to less total score.Have fun!
